subject: fix(app): consume navigation query params on route changes (#3978)
summary: Adds a consumeNavigationQuery() function that strips view and logs query parameters from the URL during app initialization while preserving unrelated parameters, fixing stale deep-link parameters from overriding the selected view after a reload.
verdict_reason: Small, well-scoped bug fix with thorough test coverage, substantive review by a reviewer with relevant app/GUI expertise, and all CI checks passing.
